rationale: Fixed-size chunks ensure predictable embedding cost and latency. Overlap preserves context at split boundaries so skill lists or job titles that straddle two chunks appear in both vectors, improving retrieval recall.

tradeoffs.chunk_size_too_small: More vectors, cheaper per-query but context fragmented
tradeoffs.chunk_size_too_large: Fewer vectors, semantic dilution hurts precision
tradeoffs.overlap_too_low: Boundary artefacts — terms split across chunks are missed
tradeoffs.chosen_rationale: 800 chars (~200 tokens) chosen to capture a full skills block or experience entry in one chunk; 100 char overlap covers ~1-2 resume lines for continuity.
